name: Malchus
bio: Malchus, a servant of the high priest, was present when the armed crowd led by Judas came to arrest Jesus in the garden; when Simon Peter drew his sword in defense, he cut off Malchus's right ear. Jesus rebuked Peter and (per Luke's account) healed the ear (John 18:10; Luke 22:50-51). A kinsman of Malchus later recognized Peter in the high priest's courtyard and challenged him, prompting one of Peter's three denials (John 18:26).
